# TASK-015 Report job cadence

Status: ready

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence the business wants.

## Notes

- Issue #31 (opened in May) says: "make the report job run weekly".
- The current value is in src/report_job.js.

## Requested completion

Mira Example: "Please get this one done today." Requested completion date:
2026-10-22 (Asia/Taipei). This deadline applies to TASK-015.

## Cadence decision reference

Follow ADR 0023 for the cadence, rather than the older request in issue #31.
The supersession chain is ADR 0002 → ADR 0014 → ADR 0023. ADR 0023 is
Accepted at the pinned commit below and at the decision repository's current
HEAD (the same commit).

- Repository: https://github.com/example/mira-decisions.git (local: ../mira-decisions)
- Path: docs/adr/0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md
- Commit: 1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
- Computed digest: sha256:bea52c60547bd724a259f12e94614147bafc87856a3a4f0a9e28c339e0ce7366

Cadence selection is complete; feature implementation remains pending.
